Subject: Acme Fintech - Procurement & PO process follow-up

Hi Sofia / Tom —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the procurement path and timeline: 

Call recap (quick):
- Use case: Acme will route realtime risk-scoring and post-transaction note generation through a dedicated Redwood instance.
- Key success criteria: sub-200ms 95th percentile latency for single-request scoring, consistent costs under projected volume.

Ask / information we need from your side:
1) Economic buyer: who owns the budget / final sign-off for a paid production pilot? (name, role, email)
2) Legal / Security: any standard compliance questionnaires or required evidence (SOC2, DPA, security whitepaper)? If you have an internal checklist we can review, please share.
3) Procurement onboarding: who handles vendor onboarding and PO issuance? Typical items we see: vendor form, W-9 (US), PO template, invoicing cadence, and payment terms (Net30/Net45).
4) Timeline: ideal start date for pilot and any hard procurement cutoffs.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm names/emails for the economic buyer and procurement contact.
- If procurement can share a vendor onboarding form or PO template, we’ll start filling it out and can loop in our finance contact.
- We’ll provision a dedicated pilot and a short mutual-action plan (MAP) once procurement requirements are clear.

I’ve CC'd Lauren (solutions lead) to help with the onboarding form and technical checklist. I’ll loop in Rishi (sales leader) if we need executive approvals on pricing/credits.

Thanks — can you confirm the procurement contact and whether Acme raises PO before or after onboarding?

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers below and a rough stakeholder map: 

Stakeholders:
- Tom Ellis (CFO) — economic buyer; will approve final budget and sign PO. tom.ellis@acmefintech.com
- Mark Jensen (Head of Legal) — legal review of DPA and contract terms. mark.jensen@acmefintech.com
- Procurement Team (procurement@acmefintech.com) — owns vendor onboarding, PO issuance, and payment terms.
- Security/InfoSec (security@acmefintech.com) — will want SOC2 / architecture diagram. I’ll introduce them if we get past the initial procurement steps.

Procurement process (typical):
1) Vendor onboarding form + W-9 -> Procurement
2) Procurement does vendor due diligence (1-2 wks depending on queue)
3) PO issued -> Finance sets up payment terms (usually Net30)

Timeline: we’re targeting a pilot kick-off the week of Mar 1. Procurement said vendor onboarding should be completed by mid-Feb to hit that date, so if Redwood can start the onboarding paperwork this week that would help.

I’m looping in procurement on this thread — procurement, can you confirm receipt and share Acme’s PO template if you have one?

Thanks,
Sofia
